system.name: CTC-NAST
system.one_liner: Non-autoregressive speech translation with two CTC-guided encoders plus prediction-aware encoding, cross-layer attention and curriculum learning.

content.variant_note: (a) base two-encoder network, (b) a pair of Transformer layers with the added cross-layer attention, (c) the prediction-aware encoding computed on toy CTC distributions, with a key
content.argues: An encoder-only speech translation model guided by CTC on source and target sides, made stronger by feeding predictions back (PAE), cross-layer attention for reordering, and mixing in ground truth.
content.subject: Base two-encoder network, a Transformer layer pair with cross-layer attention, and prediction-aware encoding on toy CTC distributions.

encoding.shape_means: Rounded rectangle = module; large rounded frame = layer or encoder group; circle = vector; small square = probability cell; circled plus = addition.
encoding.marker_means: Circled 1 and 2 name the predicted and mixed representations; letters (a)-(c) name panels; the printed 0.6-0.9 mark the top probability of each position.
encoding.emphasis: The new blocks get their own panels and salmon or red accents (Cross-Layer Attn in (b); circled 1, 2 and the plus in (c)); the key box lets the diagram stay unlabelled.

summary: CTC-NAST is an encoder-only non-autoregressive speech translation model in which an acoustic encoder and a textual encoder are each guided by a CTC head, one for the source transcription and one for the translation. Three panels show it. (a) is the base architecture, drawn bottom-up with two framed encoder groups and loss arrows to the source and target sentences. (b) zooms into two Transformer layers and shows the cross-layer attention module between self-attention and FFN, fed from an earlier layer by a peach curve. (c) draws prediction-aware encoding: word-embedding circles times toy probability columns give a predicted representation, and a curriculum variant replaces some positions by reference-based vectors; a dotted key defines the glyphs.

notes: Prior label kept (model-anatomy, overview-plus-zoom). Panels (b) and (c) are matched to (a) through the caption only, there are no leader lines. The yellow circles at the bottom right of (c) are unlabelled and read as the intermediate-layer representation h_l named in the text. The paper text calls the circled numbers 1 (prediction) and 2 (ground truth); the legend names them Predicted and Mixed Representation. Colours are reused with different meanings from panel to panel, so they are described per panel.
